name: kettlebell double alternating hang clean
description: You clean two kettlebells alternately from a hang to the rack. It works the hips, back, shoulders and grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, a kettlebell hanging in each hand.
Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and clean one kettlebell to the rack position at your shoulder, keeping it close to your body.
Lower it back to the hang as you clean the other one.
Keep alternating sides in a steady rhythm.
